description: A four-input stereo mixer with a level and a pan control on each channel, a master level, a pair of sub inputs into the mix bus and a stereo meter

params.text: Sets the level of that channel before the pan control; the knob is squared, so the travel is finer at the quiet end, and fully clockwise passes the input at unity
Places that channel between the left and right mix busses; centred sends half the level to each side, and either extreme sends all of it to one side and none to the other
Sets the level of OUT L and OUT R; the knob is squared and multiplied by four, so the centre passes the mix at unity and fully clockwise gives four times that

inputs.text: One of the four channel inputs; a DC blocker and a clamp at ±10V come before its LEVEL control
Added straight into the left mix bus, after the four channels and before MASTER, for an effects return or for chaining another mixer in
Added straight into the right mix bus, after the four channels and before MASTER, for an effects return or for chaining another mixer in

outputs.text: The left mix: the four channels plus SUB IN L, scaled by MASTER
The right mix: the four channels plus SUB IN R, scaled by MASTER
The left mix of the four channels alone, taken before SUB IN L is added and before MASTER
The right mix of the four channels alone, taken before SUB IN R is added and before MASTER

notes: the meter steps in 6dB and its 0dB lamp lights at 5V peak, which is the nominal level for audio in Eurorack.
every LEVEL knob comes up at zero, so nothing reaches the outputs until you raise one.
